description: A non-routable navigation category containing child pages.
title: Norna page category
markdownDescription:
```yaml
label: Guides
```

`category.yaml` creates a navigation-only group for child pages. It has no page content and produces no URL of its own.

[Navigation category reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.19/docs/pages.md#navigation-categories)
